SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT T.*, (SELECT LISTAGG(O.ORGNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY O.ID) FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC_ORG D, T_CORE_ORG O WHERE D.USEDORGID = O.ID AND D.PROCID = T.ID) USEDORGNAME, M.SERVICENAME, M.TABLENAME FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC T LEFT JOIN T_CORE_MENU_EXT M ON T.SERVICEID = M.ID AND M.TYPE = 'audit_def') T
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC P WHERE P.PROCCODE = T.PROCCODE AND P.PROCVERSION > T.PROCVERSION) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_DRAFT D WHERE D.PROCCODE = T.PROCCODE AND D.PROCVERSION = T.PROCVERSION + 1)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC P WHERE P.PROCCODE = T.PROCCODE AND P.PROCVERSION > T.PROCVERSION)
ORDER BY
T.PROCCODE DESC, T.PROCVERSION DESC

SELECT T.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC_ORG WHERE PROCID = T.ID) ORGQTY FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC T WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_MENU_EXT M WHERE T.SERVICEID = M.ID AND M.TYPE = 'audit_def' AND M.TABLENAME = #{tableName}) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC_ORG O WHERE O.PROCID = T.ID) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC_ORG O WHERE O.PROCID = T.ID AND O.USEDORGID = #{usedOrgId})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC P WHERE P.PROCCODE = T.PROCCODE AND P.PROCVERSION > T.PROCVERSION)
SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC T WHERE T.SERVICEID = #{serviceId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_PROC P WHERE P.PROCCODE = T.PROCCODE AND P.PROCVERSION > T.PROCVERSION)
